pageTitle: Ribbons and Bows Cake Pack Line
headline: Every cake pack checked, not a sample.
label: #FFFFFF
visitLine: Call and visit to Coburg North
heroLede: With many cakes in similar packs, the label is what tells your customer what they are buying. Here's what a camera check could look like on your packing line. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every pack has its lid on and closed properly. A lid that pops open damages the cake and comes back as a complaint.
labelLede: A chocolate mud cake and a carrot and walnut cake are easy to tell apart by eye, but not always by label at line speed, and one of them carries tree nuts. The camera checks every pack carries the right label for the cake inside, straight and intact.
codeLede: Fresh cakes have a short use-by window, so the date has to be right on every pack. The system reads the printed date and batch code and compares them with the cake and date set at changeover.
objectLede: Glove pieces, board offcuts and loose parts can end up close to the line. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before it reaches a crate.

vocab.alert: Four lids not closed in fifteen minutes. Check the lidder.
vocab.wrongCode: Wrong month: OCT printed, NOV expected
